grading.scale: 100-point scale: 90s A range, 80s B, 70s C, 60s D, 59 and below F; within each range x0-x2 is a minus, x3-x6 the plain letter, x7-x9 a plus (F has no plus/minus)
grading.drop: The lowest Vocabulary quizzie and the lowest Grammar quizzie are each dropped, and the dropped grade may be a zero from an absence or lateness.
grading.extraCredit: None; the syllabus says there is no extra credit.

exams.name: Li'l Opportunity I
exams.note: cumulative with recent chapters emphasized; sight translation, parsing and grammar questions

exams.name: BIG Opportunity
exams.note: same format; cumulative with recent chapters emphasized

GREK 1001.finalExam: No separate final is named; the BIG Opportunity is cumulative, and a missed one must be made up before the finals period ends.

materials.item: Athenaze: An Introduction to Ancient Greek, Book I (Balme and Lawall, Oxford)

GREK 1001.attendance: Up to ten absences are allowed and need no excuse; eleven or more means automatic failure, even if all are excusable. Athletes and others with scheduled absences must hand in their schedule before the
GREK 1001.lateWork: Homepractice: late or deficient work loses 1/3 point plus another 1/3 point per weekday until fixed, and work never turned in gets 0. An Online Hour not completed on time gets 0.
GREK 1001.makeups: A Homepractice due on an absence day can be handed in the day after returning without penalty, and at most one quizzie of each type can be made up. An Opportunity can be made up only for extreme, docu
other: Repeated late arrivals bring a warning, then 5 points off the final grade per offense.
Arriving late or being absent on a quizzie day (excused or not) earns 0 for that quizzie.
The weighting of the Opportunities may be adjusted in cases of significant improvement over time.
